fakeplayerproxy.consent.title: Allow proxy connection?
fakeplayerproxy.consent.body:
This server is requesting permission to proxy your connection.

If allowed, the server can decrypt, inspect, and modify game data sent over this connection.

Server address: %s. 

Your Minecraft access token is not sent to the server.

If declined, the client will use standard Minecraft encryption. The server will only transparently forward the encrypted TCP traffic.
fakeplayerproxy.consent.check: Do not notify me again for this server.
fakeplayerproxy.consent.warning: Only allow proxying on servers you trust!

fakeplayerproxy.auto_reconnect.consent.b:
FakePlayerProxy needs your Minecraft access token to enable auto-reconnect. If you select Allow, it can use the token to reconnect as your account.

Your token is not saved to disk. FakePlayerProxy clears it when auto-reconnect stops.
fakeplayerproxy.auto_reconnect.consent.w: Only use this feature on a server that you trust!
